Create a new implementation in `Solution.java` for an in-memory study-group registry. Define nested classes `Registry` and immutable `Member`. Expose these public static methods: `Registry createRegistry()`, `void addMember(Registry, long id, String givenName, String familyName)`, `boolean subscribe(Registry, long subscriberId, long topicOwnerId)`, `boolean unsubscribe(Registry, long subscriberId, long topicOwnerId)`, `List<Member> search(Registry, String givenQuery, String familyQuery)`, and `List<Member> subscriptions(Registry, long memberId)`. IDs must be unique and non-negative. Names must be non-null and non-blank; trim them when stored. Invalid additions throw `IllegalArgumentException`. A null registry throws `NullPointerException`. Subscribe/unsubscribe throw `IllegalArgumentException` if either ID is unknown. Self-subscription is forbidden and returns false. Subscribe returns false for an existing relationship; unsubscribe returns false for a missing relationship. Search is case-insensitive exact matching after query trimming. A null or blank query is a wildcard; if both are wildcards, return all members. Search results and subscriptions must be sorted by ascending member ID, unmodifiable snapshots, and unaffected by later registry mutations. `Member` exposes `id()`, `givenName()`, and `familyName()`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
